audit.whatIsWrong: The packet flagged 'NO cooldown-sequencing advice anywhere' and it was right — not one number appeared on the page.
audit.why: Mistral Bolt 8/7/6/5/4s at 1200 range, Personal Space 16/15/14/13/12s at 475, Looming Darkness 12s flat at 800, Shadow Surge 140/120/100s at 2000/2500/3000.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page repeatedly taught that Vex's passive punishes 'Karma's dash-based bursts' and told you to avoid 'Mantra-Q dash-adjacent movement'. Karma has no dash in her kit. It also framed Karma as the longer-ranged champion, which is backwards.
audit.why: Doom 'n Gloom marks enemies who DASH near her and interrupts dashes — Karma's Q, W, E and Mantra contain no dash, so that half of her passive is dead against you. The live interaction is the reverse: Mistral Bolt reaches 1200 to Inner Flame's 950 and accelerates mid-flight, so Vex, not Karma, wins a pure range war; Karma wins on her whiffs and on the 475-range Personal Space step-in.
